automatedReviewActive.description: Indicates whether automated review processes are currently active. A value of true means that automated reviews are enabled, while false means they are disabled.

baseBranches.description: List of base branches for the pull request.

ignorePaths.description: List of file paths to ignore during the review.

ignoredTitleKeywords.description: List of keywords to ignore in the title.

isRequestChangesActive.description: Indicates whether to change status to 'Request Changes' if a critical suggestions is found.

pullRequestApprovalActive.description: Indicates whether pull request approvals are currently active. A value of true means that pull request approvals are enabled, while false means they are disabled.

breaking_changes.description: Enable checks for breaking changes during the review.

code_style.description: Enable code style checks during the review.

documentation_and_comments.description: Enable checks for documentation and comments during the review.

error_handling.description: Enable error handling checks during the review.

kody_rules.description: Enable Kody rules checks during the review.

maintainability.description: Enable maintainability checks during the review.

performance_and_optimization.description: Enable performance and optimization checks during the review.

potential_issues.description: Enable checks for potential issues during the review.

refactoring.description: Enable refactoring checks during the review.

security.description: Enable security checks during the review.

runOnDraft.description: Indicates whether the review should run on draft pull requests.

showStatusFeedback.description: Indicates whether Kody should send skip/error status feedback using emoji reactions or comments.

applyFiltersToKodyRules.description: Whether to apply all filters (severity and quantity) to Kody Rules. When false, Kody Rules ignore all filters.

groupingMode.description: Defines the grouping mode for suggestions.

limitationType.description: Defines the limitation type for suggestions.

maxSuggestions.description: Maximum number of suggestions to provide.

severityLevelFilter.description: Filter for the severity level of suggestions.

severityLimits.description: Limits for suggestions by severity level. Only used when limitationType is 'severity'.

critical.description: Maximum number of critical severity suggestions.

high.description: Maximum number of high severity suggestions.

low.description: Maximum number of low severity suggestions.

medium.description: Maximum number of medium severity suggestions.

behaviourForExistingDescription.description: Defines how to handle existing descriptions.

behaviourForNewCommits.description: Defines how Kody updates the summary when new commits arrive.

customInstructions.description: Custom instructions for the pull request review.

generatePRSummary.description: Indicates whether to generate a summary for the pull request.
